queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'DisplayLink Graphics' AND publisher = 'DisplayLink Corp.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'DisplayLink Graphics' AND publisher = 'DisplayLink Corp.' AND version_compare(version, '12.2.2412.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'displaylink usb graphics software.exe');
